         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY f.CDSCode
           ORDER BY f."Academic Year" DESC

  FROM frpm AS f
),
school_data AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode,

           WHEN 'Locally Funded' THEN 2

WITH virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.School
  FROM schools AS s
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
), county_counts AS (
  SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS virtual_school_count
  FROM virtual_schools
  GROUP BY County
), ranked_counties AS (
  SELECT County, virtual_school_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC) AS county_rank
  FROM county_counts
), school_reading AS (
  SELECT v.County, v.School, ss.AvgScrRead,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY v.County
           ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC
         ) AS reading_rank
  FROM virtual_schools AS v
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss
    ON ss.cds = v.CDSCode AND ss.rtype = 'S'
), county_top_schools AS (
  SELECT County,
         CASE WHEN MAX(AvgScrRead) IS NULL THEN 'None'
              ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(
                CASE WHEN reading_rank = 1 THEN School END, ', '
              )
         END AS top_reading_school
  FROM school_reading
  GROUP BY County
)
SELECT rc.County AS county_name,
       rc.virtual_school_count,
       cts.top_reading_school
FROM ranked_counties AS rc
JOIN county_top_schools AS cts ON cts.County = rc.County
WHERE rc.county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY rc.virtual_school_count DESC, rc.County;

WITH months(month_num) AS (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pl.PostId) AS post_count
  FROM postLinks pl
  JOIN posts p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
  WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
    AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
    AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
  GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER)
)

FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts mc ON mc.month_num = m.month_num

  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT month_num + 1 FROM months WHERE month_num < 12
), monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pl.PostId) AS post_count
  FROM postLinks pl
  JOIN posts p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
  WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
    AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
    AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
  GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER)

  SELECT m.month_num, COALESCE(mc.post_count, 0) AS post_count
  FROM months m

SELECT month_num, post_count,
       ROUND(AVG(post_count) OVER (), 2) AS average_across_2010_months

WITH risky_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ta.team_api_id
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
duplicate_names AS (
  SELECT t.team_short_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS club_count
  FROM Team t
  JOIN risky_teams r ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.team_short_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) > 1
),
attributes_on_date AS (
  SELECT
    ta.team_api_id,
    ta.chanceCreationPassing,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id
      ORDER BY ta.date DESC, ta.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  WHERE ta.date <= '2014-09-19'
)
SELECT
  dn.team_short_name AS short_name,
  dn.club_count,
  ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM duplicate_names dn
JOIN Team t ON t.team_short_name = dn.team_short_name
JOIN risky_teams r ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN attributes_on_date a
  ON a.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
 AND a.rn = 1
GROUP BY dn.team_short_name, dn.club_count
ORDER BY avg_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, dn.team_short_name ASC

WITH transaction_by_district AS (

        a.district_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' AND t.operation = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' AND t.operation = 'standing order' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_standing_order_debit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' AND t.operation = 'withdrawal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
account_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account

),
qualifying AS (

        d.A2 AS district_name,

        d.A11 AS population,
        tbd.total_withdrawn,
        tbd.total_withdrawn * 1.0 / d.A11 AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY tbd.total_withdrawn * 1.0 / d.A11 DESC
        ) AS withdrawal_rank,
        ROUND(tbd.total_standing_order_debit * 1.0 / ac.account_count, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN transaction_by_district AS tbd ON tbd.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN account_counts AS ac ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A11 >= 100000
      AND tbd.withdrawal_count > 0
)

WITH
params AS (
  SELECT '1996-12-31' AS cutoff, '1997-01-01' AS year_start, '1998-01-01' AS year_end
),
branch AS (
  SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Tabor'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS opened_date,
    o.gender,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', p.cutoff) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', o.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', p.cutoff) < strftime('%m-%d', o.birth_date)) AS age_years
  FROM account a
  JOIN branch b ON b.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE a.date <= p.cutoff
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count
  FROM disp d
  JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.issued <= p.cutoff
  GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loan_summary AS (
  SELECT
    l.account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'repaying'
      ELSE 'paid off'
    END AS loan_standing
  FROM loan l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE l.date <= p.cutoff
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
activity AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('debit', 'cash withdrawal', 'cash_withdrawal')
             THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
    MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
  FROM trans t
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE t.date >= p.year_start
    AND t.date < p.year_end
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
profile AS (
  SELECT
    b.account_id,
    b.opened_date,
    b.gender,
    b.age_years,
    COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
    COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ls.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
    COALESCE(ac.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ac.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(ac.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
    COALESCE(ac.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN card_counts cc ON cc.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_summary ls ON ls.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN activity ac ON ac.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  opened_date,
  gender,
  age_years,
  card_count,
  loan_count,
  loan_standing,
  transaction_count,
  money_in,
  money_out,
  peak_balance,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profile
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitRef, r.time,
         CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
         CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
         CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND length(r.time) >= 8
), extremes AS (
  SELECT MIN(seconds) AS earliest_seconds, MAX(seconds) AS latest_seconds
  FROM starts
), endpoints AS (
  SELECT 'earliest' AS endpoint, earliest_seconds AS seconds,
         latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
  FROM extremes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'latest', latest_seconds, latest_seconds - earliest_seconds
  FROM extremes
)
SELECT e.endpoint, s.circuitRef, e.seconds AS start_seconds, e.gap_seconds
FROM endpoints e
JOIN starts s ON s.seconds = e.seconds
ORDER BY CASE e.endpoint WHEN 'earliest' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.circuitRef;

  FROM races r

  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND length(r.time) >= 8

  FROM race_times

  latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM extremes;

  SELECT e.type AS event_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
  FROM event e
  JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND e.event_date < '2020-06-01'
  GROUP BY e.type
), ranked AS (
  SELECT event_type, member_count,
         MAX(member_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM attendance_by_type
)
SELECT event_type, member_count
FROM ranked
WHERE member_count = max_count;
